name: Auto Gather
description: Automatically harvests nearby life-resource nodes — pick a resource type and it walks to and gathers every node of that type, with an optional Focus mode.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Pick a resource type from the nearby list, then press Start.
Auto-Gather farming an ore vein — it walks to and harvests every node of the locked type on its own.

added: Automatically farms life-resource nodes: pick a resource type from the nearby list and press Start — it walks to and gathers every node of that type on its own.
Focus mode option spends Focus for rarer gathers, and stops on its own when you run out of Focus.
Auto-closes the daily reward popup so long unattended sessions aren't interrupted.
Available in English, 日本語, ไทย, Bahasa Indonesia, and Filipino.
